catalog.ts: Zod schemas (TypeChart/Move/Species/Catalog) + validateCatalog with fix-naming errors (unknown types/moveIds/evolution targets, dup ids, unsorted learnset, missing level-1 move, bad multipliers). Decisions: type chart supports PARTIAL coverage — missing pairs default to 1.0 so only non-neutral matchups need listing; single atk/def pair so physical/special is descriptive; move effects kept minimal as one-stage raise_/lower_ atk/def/spd (raise targets self, lower targets opponent) so status moves do something. Helpers: speciesById, moveById, statsAtLevel (hp=floor(2b*L/100)+L+10, others +5), movesKnownAtLevel (last 4), typeMultiplier. Fixture test/fixtures/catalog.json: 6 types, 13 moves, 8 species incl emberling->pyrewyrm line, mosskrag dual rock/grass, puddlit. 11 catalog tests pass.

battle.ts: deterministic Battle class, all randomness via injected Rng. Damage floor((floor((2L/5+2)*power*atk/max(1,def))/50+2)*stab*typeMult*roll), STAB 1.5, roll U[0.85,1.0], min 1 dmg when typeMult>0. Turn order by stage-modified spd, rng tiebreak. Escape chance clamp(0.5+0.1*(pSpd-eSpd)/max(1,eSpd), 0.1, 0.95) using stage-free spd, wild only. PP decrements; 0-PP move rejected without consuming round; all-PP-exhausted falls back to built-in Flail (normal/20/never misses). Faint -> needsSwitch free switch (no enemy hit); voluntary switch gives enemy a free attack; enemy auto-replaces. Swappable EnemyAi (default random valid move). state fully JSON-serializable with outcome ongoing/player_won/enemy_won/fled. 15 battle tests pass incl determinism, effectiveness ratios, STAB, seeded miss/run, trainer-forbids-run.
